articles.title: What Democrats’ Sweeping Midterm Wins Could Mean for the Redistricting Battle
articles.summary: Republicans and Democrats in several states engaged in a bitter fight to redraw congressional maps in their parties’ favor leading up to this year’s midterms. But in the aftermath of the blue wave that swept across the country, that conflict may be dying down—at least for now. Typically, maps are redrawn after the results of the U.S. census are released each decade, in order to account for population and demographic changes. articles.title: You Can’t Cast Your Family
articles.summary: One of the first films I cast was the holiday classic National Lampoon's Christmas Vacation . I was one lucky 27-year-old when my bosses invited me to partner with them and help complete casting the Griswold family. In those days, we auditioned scores of actors in person. Almost everyone came through our doors to read for their roles, something now mostly done over Zoom or by offer only.
